name: AutoFix
description: Automatically sanitizes messy release titles, resolves missing TMDb metadata, injects posters, and cleans movie filenames in-place.
overview: Permanently eliminates blank grey boxes in Jellyfin by pre-cleaning messy release names, resolving TMDb IDs, injecting artwork, and cleanly renaming messy media files on disk without deleting any files.
